Larsen & Toubro Limited (ticker **LT** on NSE, often shown as **LT.NS**) is a **large‑cap Indian multinational engineering and construction conglomerate**, and a key constituent of both the **NIFTY 50** and **BSE Sensex** indices.[1][6] Its recent share price is quoted around **₹3,900–4,100** per share, implying a market capitalisation of roughly **₹5.3–5.6 lakh crore**.[2][3][7][10][13]

**Company overview**

- **Name:** Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T)[1]  
- **Business type:** Diversified **engineering, procurement and construction (EPC)**, **hi‑tech manufacturing**, and **services** group.[1][8][12]  
- **Key sectors:** Infrastructure, hydrocarbons/energy projects, power, heavy/defence engineering, IT & technology services, and financial services.[1][3][12][14]  
- **Headquarters:** Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.[1][6][13]  
- **Founders / history:** Founded by **Henning Holck‑Larsen** and **Søren Kristian Toubro** in 1938; incorporated in 1946.[1][14][7]  
- **Geographic presence:** Operates in **over 50 countries** worldwide, with the majority of revenue generated in India.[3][8][15]  
- **Index memberships:** Part of **BSE Sensex** and **NSE NIFTY 50**.[1]

**Business segments**

According to company and analyst profiles, L&T operates through multiple segments:[3][11][12][14]

- **Infrastructure projects** – buildings & factories, transportation, heavy civil infrastructure, power transmission & distribution, renewable energy, water and effluent treatment, minerals & metals; this is its **largest revenue contributor**.[2][3][11]  
- **Energy / Hydrocarbon projects** – onshore and offshore oil & gas, petrochemicals, and related facilities.[3][11][12]  
- **Hi‑Tech / Heavy / Defence manufacturing** – heavy engineering, defence engineering, shipbuilding, specialised equipment.[3][12][14]  
- **IT & Technology services** – via listed subsidiaries in IT and engineering services.[3][14]  
- **Financial services** – lending and related financial products.[3][14]  
- **Development projects & others** – infrastructure development and various allied activities.[3][11][14]

**Stock and valuation snapshot (LT / LT.NS)**

(Values differ slightly by source because of timing; figures are indicative, in Indian Rupees.)

- **Exchange & ticker:** NSE: **LT**; BSE: **500510**.[1][6][9]  
- **Sector / industry:** Construction / **Engineering & Construction** / Infrastructure.[6][11][13]  
- **Recent share price:**  
  - Around **₹3,918** per share on Screener.[2]  
  - Around **₹3,917.50** on Groww.[7]  
  - Around **₹4,074.10** on Morningstar.[3]  
- **Market capitalisation:**  
  - About **₹5.38 lakh crore** on Screener.[2]  
  - About **₹5.36 lakh crore** on Groww.[7]  
  - Around **₹5.33 lakh crore** on Finology.[10]  
  - Morningstar cites roughly **₹5.63 trillion**.[3]  
- **52‑week high / low:** Approximately **₹4,440 / ₹3,288**.[2][5]  
- **Face value:** **₹2** per share.[2][10]  
- **Valuation multiples:**  
  - Stock **P/E** around **32–33** (Screener) versus about **84.8** on Finology (likely based on different earnings period/definition).[2][10]  
  - **P/B** about **7.16** (Finology).[10]  
- **Profitability & returns:**  
  - **ROE** about **15.9%** and **ROCE** about **14.6%** (Screener).[2]  
- **Dividend yield:** Around **0.96–0.97%**.[2][10]  
- **Capital structure indicators:**  
  - Cash ~₹7,544 crore and debt ~₹11,773 crore (Finology).[10]  
  - Reported **promoter holding: 0%**, reflecting its professionally managed, widely held ownership base.[10][7]

**Other notable points**

- L&T is widely regarded as one of the **largest and most respected private‑sector companies in India**, particularly in infrastructure and engineering.[1][6][13]  
- The group has about **58,000+ employees**, according to Morningstar’s profile.[3]
